reasin

The goal of reasin is to provide a R interface to the API of the European Alien Species Information Network (EASIN).

At the moment only interface to the EASIN Catalogue Web Service (checklist data) is implemented. Expect more features soon.

Installation

You can install the development version of reasin from GitHub with:

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("guardias-eu/reasin") # dev version

Example

Use get_species() to retrieve information on species from the EASIN Catalogue Web Service:

library(reasin)

# Get overview with all species
get_species()

# Get details for few species via scientific name or part of it
get_species(scientific_name = "Procambarus")

More examples can be found in get_species() documentation.

Check also the Reference section for a list with all available functions.
